what: a ring (r19.6/20.8, 20 tall) joined onto an 80x80x1.2 plate with a 9x9 grid of 6.4 mm square holes; the ring's foot crosses the holes
method: plate 80x80x1.2 minus 81 holes 6.4x6.4 (pitch 8, centred): 7680 - 81*6.4^2*1.2; ring standing on the top face (touching, no overlap): pi(20.8^2-19.6^2)*20. One body. The ring's walls must stay whole cylinder faces (the old kernel cut them into full-height strips at every hole edge); the total face count is not graded because the ring's foot over the holes is not worked out here
